metaDescription: Enter any two of pre-money, investment and post-money valuation and get the third plus the investor ownership.
intro: Solves for the missing one of pre-money valuation, investment and post-money valuation and shows ownership.
why:
Post-money is pre-money plus the new investment. Investors own investment divided by post-money, and existing holders keep pre-money divided by post-money.

Leave one field at 0 and fill in the other two. The tool checks that the numbers make sense, for example that investment is smaller than post-money.
howTo: Read the third value and the ownership split.

faq.q: What is the difference between pre- and post-money?
faq.a: Pre-money is value before new cash, post-money is value after.
No. Use the cap table simulator.

faq.q: Why must exactly two be filled?
